systematicIssues: The requested data/agent_library README, manifest, and proposal-template are absent from current main, so the exact template contract could not be loaded.

Reviewed official source bindings are fragmented: some assigned Place IDs are present in data/reviewed_official_runtime_sources.json, while others are only recoverable through reviewed contact overlays or exact public official/facility pages.
Two assigned rows have different Google Place IDs but the same catalog name HUB Tokyo Dome City LaQua. Evidence is kept per Place ID and no canonical identity change is proposed.
Chain-wide recommended products cannot safely become branch-level R when the source itself warns of store-specific availability or the exact branch availability is otherwise unverified.
Owner-provided or owner-updated third-party recommendation text was retained as C rather than promoted to R when equivalent recommendation semantics were not verified on the official-domain source.
